import configparser
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

def load_plan():
    flows = json.loads(Path("config/workflows.json").read_text())
    cfg = configparser.ConfigParser()
    cfg.read("config/run.ini")
    flow = os.environ["WORKFLOW"]
    return {"workflow": flow, "graph": flows[flow],
            "order": cfg["runner"]["task_order"].split(">"),
            "workers": cfg["runner"].getint("workers")}
